I've uploaded a code repository in the directory `/src/mruby`. Consider the following issue description:

<issue_description>
A heap-buffer-overflow exists in mrbgems/mruby-bigint/core/bigint.c: the udiv routine (invoked via mpz_mdiv / mrb_bint_div) can read past the end of its allocated limb buffers during multi-precision division, causing an out-of-bounds heap read. This leads to undefined behavior that can crash the process or corrupt memory and may enable information disclosure or other memory-corruption exploits.
